integrity: Claim and proof concern ordinary negative type, not optimal distorted negative type; all calculations are reproducible; finite tests serve as checks and not universal proofs. The untouched complete-bipartite benchmark is credited to prior work.
scientific_limitations: Finite shortest-path metrics of complete bipartite graphs K_{m,n}, m,n>=2; exactly one distinguished edge stretched from 1 to s in [1,3]. Does not treat arbitrary edge lengths, multiple deformations or graphs outside this family. Critical embedding dimension refers to the p/2 snowflake. Exact published-source equivalence remains subject to specialist priority review.
title: A balance-dependent one-edge roundness reversal in complete bipartite metrics
